name: stash-backend
description: Stash media downloader backend — shared between web and mobile apps

scripts.predev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const pid = execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :4000 | findstr LISTENING', {encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if(pid && pid !== '0') { execSync('taskkill /PID ' + pid + ' /F'); console.log('Cleared port 4000 (PID ' + pid + ')'); } } catch(e) {}"
